methodology.economic_gap: G = T x economic_rate x max(target_share - q, 0)
methodology.priority: median(G) x confidence x sector fit x timing
methodology.identification: partial-identification envelope shown separately from model-based posterior
methodology.timing: seasonal-naive forecasts plus scheduled trade maturities
methodology.public_anchors: accounting identities, disclosed FX exposure/notional, and current debt maturity; all transformations are explicit

Collections.name: Audited cash-collections identity
Collections.formula: Revenue + opening trade receivables - closing trade receivables
Collections.transformation_assumption: Accounting proxy bounded at 88%/112% to allow non-cash and classification effects.

Payments.name: Audited supplier-payments identity
Payments.formula: Cost base + closing inventory - opening inventory + opening trade payables - closing trade payables
Payments.transformation_assumption: Accounting proxy bounded at 88%/112%; BHP's cost base is expenses excluding net finance costs.

Trade finance.name: Audited payments base × trade-utilisation range
Trade finance.formula: Audited supplier-payments proxy × declared sector trade-finance utilisation

Cross-border FX.name: Audited FX exposure/notional turnover range
Cross-border FX.formula: Audited FX point exposure or hedge notional × annual turnover multiple
Cross-border FX.transformation_assumption: Annual turnover low/base/high = 1.0x/2.0x/4.0x the disclosed point exposure/notional.

Liquidity.name: Audited debt-maturity liquidity range
Liquidity.formula: Current debt maturity/refinancing amount × declared liquidity multiple
Liquidity.transformation_assumption: Liquidity low/base/high = 0.75x/1.00x/1.50x current debt and facilities.
